claims.text: The hotel is on Pennsylvania Avenue between the White House and the U.S. Capitol, near the National Mall museums, the Washington Monument and the Lincoln Memorial.

findings.quote: Our hotel sits on Pennsylvania Avenue between The White House and the U.S. Capitol near National Mall museums, the Washington Monument, and Lincoln Memorial.

claims.text: Construction of the Romanesque Revival building began in 1892 as headquarters for the US Post Office Department.

findings.quote: Construction began in 1892 for this Romanesque Revival-style structure as a grand HQ for the US Post Office Department

claims.text: Original details such as arching metal truss-work are preserved alongside new oversized chandeliers and velvet couches.

findings.quote: preserved original details like arching metal truss-work are juxtaposed with new additions like oversized chandeliers and velvet couches

claims.text: Peacock Alley serves cocktails beneath crystal sconces and chandeliers; its namesake cocktail, The Waldorf, is a twist on a classic Manhattan.

findings.quote: Sip cocktails under the glittering crystal sconces and chandeliers in Peacock Alley
you'll want to order the namesake cocktail, The Waldorf—a twist on a classic Manhattan

claims.text: Afternoon Tea is served beneath the atrium, with savory bites, scones, pastries and free-flowing champagne.

findings.quote: Meet us at the clock for Afternoon Tea beneath our soaring atrium — savory bites, scones, exquisite pastries, and free-flowing champagne await.

claims.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours.

findings.quote: In-room dining is also available 24 hours for your comfort and convenience.

claims.text: Guest rooms and suites offer views of Pennsylvania Avenue.

findings.quote: Enjoy spectacular views of Pennsylvania Avenue, exquisite furnishings, and luxury amenities.

claims.text: Turret nooks are found in the suites and some king and queen rooms.

findings.quote: these nooks can be found in the hotel's luxurious suites as well as some of the king and queen rooms

claims.text: The spa is located one floor below Peacock Alley.

findings.quote: located one floor below Peacock Alley

claims.text: Event venues include the Grand Ballroom, the historic Lincoln Library and the Franklin Study, with 34,000 square feet of event space.

findings.quote: With 34,000 sq. ft. of event space
Host a glamorous reception in the Grand Ballroom or choose from the historic Lincoln Library or Franklin Study

claims.text: Kids' menus and amenities for children are offered, and adjoining rooms and suites are available.

findings.quote: You'll find kids' menus and other amenities for visiting little ones. In addition to spacious guest rooms with two queen beds, adjoining rooms and suites are available.

claims.text: A popular concierge excursion tours the monuments by moonlight on golf carts with a private guide.

findings.quote: one popular excursion gives you a terrific view of DC's monuments in the moonlight as you zip around the Mall on golf carts with a private tour guide

claims.text: The hotel occupies the restored Old Post Office building.

findings.quote: the iconic Old Post Office has been reimagined as Waldorf Astoria Washington DC

claims.text: A nine-story atrium serves as the lobby and as the main restaurant and bar, Peacock Alley.

findings.quote: a nine-story atrium acts as the hotel's lobby and main restaurant and bar, dubbed Peacock Alley

claims.text: The Old Post Office Tower's observation deck is free for visitors and has 360-degree views of the District.

findings.quote: the Old Post Office Tower's 270-foot observation deck is free for visitors and includes 360-degree views of the District

claims.text: The Waldorf Astoria Spa has treatment rooms including a couple's suite and a Himalayan Salt Therapy Room.

findings.quote: featuring six luxurious treatment rooms, including a couple’s suite and a soothing Himalayan Salt Therapy Room

claims.text: The hotel has The Bazaar by José Andrés, with cuisine rooted in Spanish heritage.

findings.quote: step into a world of culinary imagination rooted in Spanish heritage and layered with luxurious detail at The Bazaar by José Andrés

claims.text: This is a downtown base, with Penn Quarter's restaurant scene on the doorstep.

findings.quote: feels far from the noise of downtown
with Penn Quarter's buzzy restaurant scene on your doorstep

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing.
WhataHotel notes a busy downtown location with city traffic.
